source_text: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) maintains a firm stance against all forms of FGM/C, defining it as procedures involving partial or total removal of external female genitalia or other injury for non-medical reasons, with no health benefits and significant risks including infection, hemorrhage, and psychological trauma. [85]
